app.title: Zero Mail
app.description: Reach inbox zero without giving up control.

landing.heading: Zero Mail
landing.tagline: AI auto-triage for Gmail. This page is being finalized.

login.title: Sign in
login.headline: Reach inbox zero without giving up control.
login.body: Zero Mail connects to Gmail so you can set safe, reviewable automation rules. This phase only stores your account, connection, and onboarding choices.

consent_denied.title: Gmail access was declined
consent_denied.body: Zero Mail needs Gmail access to triage your inbox. Click Sign in with Google to try again.

gmail_scope_required.title: Gmail permission missing
gmail_scope_required.body: Sign in worked, but Gmail access wasn't granted. Click Sign in with Google and approve the Gmail permission to continue.

connect.heading: Connect Gmail to finish setup
connect.body: Zero Mail needs a Gmail grant before later phases can watch, label, archive, or draft. You can revoke access anytime.

template.heading: Choose a starter template
template.body: A starter template helps Zero Mail understand how you want your inbox handled. You can change it later in Settings.

completion.heading: You're ready. Open Settings to review your choices.

gmailConnection.heading: Gmail connection
gmailConnection.singleAccountNote: Zero Mail v1 supports one Gmail account, the email you logged in with. Multi-account support is on the roadmap.

language.label: Language
language.helper: This language preference applies to your account on every device.

privacy.heading: Privacy and safety
privacy.noBodyStorage: No long-term storage of email bodies, prompts, or AI completions
privacy.byokPlanned: Coming soon: you can bring your own API key (BYOK)

receipts.title: Receipts and invoices
receipts.description: Label invoices, receipts, and order confirmations so they're easy to find later.

newsletters.title: Newsletters
newsletters.description: Auto-label newsletters so the primary inbox stays clean.

calendarInvites.title: Calendar invites
calendarInvites.description: Flag meeting invitations so you don't miss them.

connectionHealth.reconnectPrompt: Google access was revoked or expired. Reconnect Gmail to continue setup.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account and data?
deleteAccount.body: This removes your tenant, Gmail connection, onboarding selections, sessions, and encrypted tokens. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.success: Your account and data have been deleted.
